Nadia (Finance): Hey team — two quick updates: 1) Corporate card policy tightening starting July 15. 2) Weare switching procurement systems to Procurely on Aug 1. Read the short summary: https://intra.redwood.com/finance/procurely-migration :sparkles:

Tom (Ops): Can you summarize what changes cardholders will see?

Nadia (Finance): Sure. Main points:
- Single purchase limit drops from $2,500 -> $1,500 for non-approved vendors.
- Any recurring subscription (monthly) must have a Procurely request if > $300/mo.
- Cardholders must add project_tag + cost_center on every transaction; missing tags will auto-flag and may delay reimbursements.

Elena (Eng): Will Procurely replace the current vendor-onboard form? Any migration steps for active POs?

Nadia (Finance): Procurely will be the single source for requests/onboarding. Active POs will be migrated automatically; you should verify by Jul 25 that your critical vendors appear in Procurely. If not, submit a manual migrate request to procure@redwood.com.

Kofi (Sales): What about client entertainment and customer dinners booked on the card? Also limits for travel per diems?

Nadia (Finance): Customer-facing meal approvals remain but need pre-authorization if >$200. Travel caps unchanged for now — travel team will publish country per-diems in Procurely.

Rae (Legal): Reminder: any vendor contracts that include AI model evals, data access, or infra credentials need Legal sign-off before Finance issues a PO. Use the Contract Intake in Procurely. No exceptions.

Elena (Eng): Small ask: we have a short-term bench of GPUs billed $1,800 this month from a new vendor. Does that need PO now?

Nadia (Finance): Since it's below the $1,500 threshold it's slightly over; please submit a Procurely fast-track with notes "PO-request: short bench" and tag project=bench-testing. If it's recurring, Procurely will require longer approval.

VendorBot: SYSTEM: Procurely migration prep checklist emailed to all approvers. Vendors marked as "unverified" will be temporarily limited on Aug 1.

Tom (Ops): Timeline recapped: July 15 card rules tighten; Jul 25 verify vendors; Aug 1 Procurely goes live. Well run a 30-min demo/walkthrough next Wed 11am PT.

Nadia (Finance): TL;DR: lower ad-hoc card limit for non-approved vendors, Procurely rollout Aug 1, tag everything, Legal review required for data/infra access. Please read the migration note and complete vendor verification by Jul 25. Questions? Reply here or email procure@redwood.com. Thanks! :pray:
